I am very much interested in Thableeg Jamath and also went for 40 days. Answer ID: 3406 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 210/206=J) Till this time no one has appeared who had the signs and conditions of Hazrat Mahdi mentioned in hadith. A person who says that Hazrat Mahdi appeared and died too, such a person is utter liar and fabricator; it is unlawful to pray salah behind him. Try to convince your relatives that such a belief is a cause of kufr (disbelief), it must be avioded absolutely. For details you should study the book: Alamaat-e-Qiyamat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
